title: Creative Fatigue on Meta: Should You Outsource Your Ad Creative?
summary: If the same few ads keep losing results, creative fatigue is the likely cause. Learn when outsourcing ad creative fixes it, and what to check first.
body_markdown:
## Which providers fit this spend?


The table compares published numbers, with Knowlify first. Volume figures are the providers' own claims.


Provider Published fit Creative volume as published Published price


Knowlify (our top pick) Teams that need finished AI video ads each week About 25 finished ads a week From $5,000 a month


[MetaAdsAgency](https://metaadsagency.com/pricing) Brands spending up to $50,000 a month on Meta on the Growth plan 12 new creatives and 2 UGC-style videos a month $2,400 a month billed yearly ($3,000 billed monthly)


[Flighted](https://www.flighted.co/) DTC and ecommerce brands spending $20,000 or more a month More than 1,000 creatives a month, per its own claim Not published


[inBeat](https://inbeat.agency/paid-social-agency) Creator-led ads alongside paid social 8 to 15 new concepts a month Not published


[Adside AI](https://www.adside.ai/pricing) Managed Meta service Not stated per fee 10% of ad spend, $3,500 monthly minimum


### Knowlify: our top pick for a weekly supply of finished ads


Creative fatigue is a supply problem, and Knowlify's output is sized for it: about 25 finished ads a week, with the first batch landing on day 5, so five ads can become dozens within a month. A person checks every ad before delivery, and the three formats (AI UGC, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials) let you change the whole look of an ad, not only the hook. You can add[end-to-end Meta management](https://knowlify.com/facebook-ads-agency) so one team launches the new ads and reads the results, or buy creative only if you already have a media buyer. The guarantee lets you cancel by email for a full refund if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days ([terms on the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. Pick another option if you need real human creators on camera or a landing page rebuilt, which we do not supply or build.


### MetaAdsAgency: a fixed monthly creative count


The Growth plan covers ad spend up to $50,000 a month, with no setup fee and no percentage of spend. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta. A flat fee makes the creative cost predictable, but count the 12 new creatives against what your team can approve in a month.


### Flighted: in-house editors at volume


Flighted lists in-house video editors and designers. Its[about page](https://www.flighted.co/about) lists typical client ad spend of $25,000 or more a month and says it works best with companies spending $50,000 or more a month on Meta. At $20,000, ask whether your budget is inside its typical range before you request a proposal.


### Adside AI: a percentage fee with a floor


Adside AI lists 10% of ad spend with a $3,500 monthly minimum. Its one fee covers strategy, creative production, launch, optimization and reporting. At $20,000 of monthly spend, 10% is $2,000, so the $3,500 minimum applies, by our arithmetic. The page does not say how many creatives the fee includes, so ask for that number in writing.


## When outsourcing will not fix fatigue


Outsourcing will not help when the offer is weak, when nobody can approve claims quickly, or when the ads need real customers on camera. Our UGC-style ads use AI presenters, not real creators. For creator footage,[Common Thread Collective's ad creative page](https://commonthreadco.com/pages/creative-production) sells UGC packages of 20 ads from 5 creators, 40 from 10 or 80 from 20, with three to four weeks per batch. That is slower than a weekly supply, so match the format to the refresh rate you need.


Set the approval rules before the first batch, as our[video ad approval workflow](https://knowlify.com/articles/video-ad-approval-workflow) explains, so approvals do not become the bottleneck.


## What to test first when new creative arrives


Set up the new ads so the results can be read. Our[ad creative testing guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/ad-creative-testing) covers the structure. Pilothouse, which sells creative through[Pilothouse Studios](https://www.pilothouse.co/studios) , describes a 3-3-3 testing framework in its blog: three funnel levels, three angles and three formats, tested in equal-budget ad sets before the winners move into Advantage+ sales campaigns. Test angles rather than edits, so a new batch tells you something about the customer and not just which cut performed.


## Key takeaways


- Confirm tracking, the offer and the audience before you blame creative.
- Outsourcing fixes supply, so count concepts, hook variants and finished files separately.
- At $20,000 a month, check the fit and the minimums, since a percentage fee can hit its floor.
- Knowlify is our top pick for a steady supply of finished AI video ads, with optional Meta management or creative only.
- Use AI presenters only when the ad does not need real customers or creators on camera.


## FAQ


### I'm spending $20k a month on Meta with the same five ads, who can help?


Start with a provider whose published fit covers that spend and a steady volume. Knowlify makes about 25 finished AI video ads a week, with optional Meta management or creative only. MetaAdsAgency's Growth plan covers up to $50,000 a month with 12 new creatives and 2 UGC-style videos. Ask each candidate for the concept count and the first delivery date in writing.


### How many new ads do I need when creative fatigue hits?


No fixed number is safe to quote, because it depends on spend, how many concepts you can approve and how fast results drop. Count distinct concepts rather than files. Meta's Andromeda post says the number of ad creatives in its systems is expected to grow, which makes a steady supply more useful than a single batch.


### Does a creative partner need to run the ads too?


No. Knowlify offers creative only for teams that already have a media buyer, or end-to-end Meta management. Choose the scope that matches who approves launches and reports results, and confirm the handoff before the first batch.


### Will new ads fix creative fatigue on their own?


Not if the audience has already seen the offer or the landing page is weak. New creative helps when the problem is supply and the rest of the account is healthy. Check tracking and the offer first, then test new concepts against each other.
